requirements.requirement: Prevent the usb-storage kernel module from loading in the current boot.
requirements.summary: The module was initially absent, an explicit load attempt was rejected by the install rule, and /proc/modules confirmed usb_storage remained absent.

requirements.requirement: Keep usb-storage blocked after a reboot.
requirements.summary: The persistent modprobe policy was installed, the current initramfs was regenerated, and a real reboot changed the boot ID. After recovery, the policy remained present, load attempts using both underscore and hyphen names failed, and the module remained absent.

requirements.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel while using mechanisms compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were unchanged after execution and reboot. The implementation used the platform's existing module-init-tools and update-initramfs utilities; no OS, kernel, or package replacement occurred.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied. Direct tests show usb-storage blocked both before and after a verified reboot, while Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained unchanged. The mandatory restart protocol is strong: it records pre-restart identity and health, schedules the restart, observes bounded SSH unavailability, records a different post-restart identity, and verifies recovered root storage, required data, SSH, and blacklist enforcement. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.
limitations: System-wide failed-service inspection was unsupported on this pre-systemd platform, so recovery evidence is based on root filesystem, required data, SSH, uptime, and task-specific behavior rather than a comprehensive service-manager health report.

The fixed listening-socket inventory was empty both before and after execution, while the executor's post-reboot netstat check directly reported the SSH listener recovered; this collector discrepancy slightly limits independent corroboration of service recovery.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Writing the modprobe policy (cmd-50ee00c2a0ef469b), regenerating the matching initramfs (cmd-07b38da15e264881), bounded enforcement tests (cmd-8e6d2fb35f5e4289, cmd-64a0e27bbcab445c, cmd-6ab30dd5482f4e0c), and rebooting (cmd-ee75ce55dc4445e5) were directly connected to implementing or verifying the required outcome. The temporary reboot log left no observed residue, package health remained consistent, and no unrelated lifecycle changes were detected.
